cinematic_dialogue:2:1826066001:.text: This is what comes of crossing me! Pah!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1826066001:.source_cn: 这就是和我作对的下场！呸！

say:5:1826067001:1.text: My, my... I certainly didn't expect Thoran to send a two-headed monstrosity my way...
say:5:1826067001:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀……托安竟然只派了一个扭曲的双头怪物来诺珐斯……

say:6:1826067002:1.text: What happened? Have all his other generals and commanders bitten the dust?
say:6:1826067002:1.source_cn: 怎么，班题斯的将军和统帅全都化作骨灰了吗？

say:7:1826067003:1.text: Hmph! Sending a general here would be overkill. Mar alone could raze all of Novaris to the ground!
say:7:1826067003:1.source_cn: 哼，收复诺珐斯根本用不着将军出马，只靠马尔就能将这里夷...

say:8:1826067004:1.text: My battleaxe... is better than any general!
say:8:1826067004:1.source_cn: 马尔的锤子——比将军更厉害！

say:9:1826067005:1.text: Well, it's good for you to have that kind of optimism. Pray tell, how is Grezhul doing?
say:9:1826067005:1.source_cn: 呵呵，是吗？不知格瑞泽尔勒卿苏醒了没有？

say:10:1826067006:1.text: He is, after all, the finest general in all of Bantus. Should he slumber for all eternity, your dear king would be utterly devastated...
say:10:1826067006:1.source_cn: 他可是班题斯帝国最骁勇善战的将军，也是托安最信任的禁卫...

say:11:1826067007:1.text: Now, suppose you were in Grezhul's place... Would Thoran be quite so distressed by your suffering?
say:11:1826067007:1.source_cn: 不过，若是你们兄弟俩遭遇此事，你们说，托安会作何反应？

say:12:1826067008:1.text: Ah... I think I know the answer. He would have you hacked to pieces and flung into a mass grave, only to raise you again as an abomination like Radu. Though, looking at you now, I daresay the work is already half done.
say:12:1826067008:1.source_cn: 哦……余知道了。托安一定会把你们剁碎丢进乱葬岗，再制成...

say:13:1826067009:1.text: H-How dare you speak ill of His Majesty?! You must have a death wish!
say:13:1826067009:1.source_cn: 你……你竟敢侮辱陛下？！简直不知死活！

say:14:1826067010:1.text: Am I supposed to tremble at the mere mention of his name? Novaris fears no one!
say:14:1826067010:1.source_cn: 侮辱他又如何？难不成班题斯真的天真地以为，诺珐斯无力与...

say:15:1826067011:1.text: Oh, and do tell Thoran that he and Grezhul were right all along—I have never truly bowed to Bantus. My family and I have always loathed your vile conduct!
say:15:1826067011:1.source_cn: 回去转告托安，恭喜他和格瑞泽尔勒猜对了，余从未真心臣服...

say:16:1826067012:1.text: The gall of you. You still think the Adamant Syndicate has your back? Open your eyes! Your master has already cut you loose!
say:16:1826067012:1.source_cn: 你这狂妄的家伙！别以为黑金商会还会为你背书，你们那个老...

say:17:1826067013:1.text: Ah, thank you for reminding me. I'd almost forgotten that Pride was in cahoots with Bantus.
say:17:1826067013:1.source_cn: 多谢你的提醒，余差点忘记和班题斯狼狈为奸的还有“傲慢”...

say:18:1826067014:1.text: Go on and tell him I've achieved my goals as Sloth. He's free to bestow the title upon whomever he pleases. Though he really ought to be more careful about whom he trusts next time.
say:18:1826067014:1.source_cn: 告诉他，余已经借用“懒惰”的名号达成了目的，往后随便他...

say:19:1826067015:1.text: As for Edward... I shall have him delivered to the Lightbearer Empire. I'm certain they'll be eager to learn all about the Adamant Syndicate's... meticulous schemes through him.
say:19:1826067015:1.source_cn: 余还会将爱德华押送往耀光帝国，相信他们一定非常乐于了解...

say:20:1826067016:1.source_cn: 而现在——该你们滚出诺珐斯了。

narration:25:1826068001:1.text: Karma charges toward the city gate, followed by the Bantus army.

narration:26:1826068002:1.text: As they surge forward, a vast magic circle blazes to life beneath them, unleashing a pillar of enchanted light that tears into the sky!

narration:27:1826068003:0.text: The next instant, cries of agony fill the air. The people of Novaris shut their eyes to shield themselves from the horrifying sight.
narration:27:1826068003:0.source_cn: 惨厉的叫声此起彼伏，许多诺珐斯居民都惊恐地闭上了双眼

narration:28:1826068004:1.text: By the time the light fades, all that remain before Tephesia are Karma and Shadewing, barely clinging to life amid the drifting dust...

cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068101:.text: Unfortunately, the two of you are no match for me.
cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068101:.source_cn: 只凭你们，可不是余的对手

cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068102:.text: Guards, take them to the dungeon!
cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068102:.source_cn: 来两个守卫，把他们押到牢里

cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068103:.text: They'll make fine bargaining chips in my dealings with Bantus.

cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068105:.text: That spell really wore me out...
cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068105:.male: That spell really wore me out...
cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068105:.female: That spell really wore me out...

cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069002:.text: That mage beside her looks suspicious.
cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069002:.source_cn: 那个魔法师的身份也很可疑
cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069002:.male: That mage beside her looks suspicious.
cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069002:.female: That mage beside her looks suspicious.

cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069003:.text: I'll inform His Majesty of his involvement.
cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069003:.male: I'll inform His Majesty of his involvement.
cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069003:.female: I'll inform His Majesty of her involvement.

narration:34:180601523:0.text: Without breaking a sweat, Tephesia defeats the entire Bantus army and captures Karma and Shadewing, intending to use them as leverage in negotiations with Bantus.
narration:34:180601523:0.source_cn: 苔佩希轻而易举地挫败了进攻的班题斯军队，擒拿了喀尔马和...

narration:35:180601522:0.text: As Karma leads his army in a charge toward the city gate, Shadewing emerges from the shadows to support him. Yet Tephesia remains perfectly unruffled.
narration:35:180601522:0.source_cn: 喀尔马率领军队冲向城门，向苔佩希发动攻击，躲藏于暗处的...

narration:36:180601521:0.text: Karma uses brute force to subdue the skeletal guards blocking his path. When Tephesia arrives, she shows nothing but disdain for his approach.
narration:36:180601521:0.source_cn: 喀尔马以暴力制服了阻拦军队的骷髅守卫，然而赶来的苔佩希...
